Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Shalini - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vikram - 41 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Vimla - 69 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Ishaan stands in the park. Shalini and Vikram stand near him.]

Ishaan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Ishaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Ishaan: "Dad, are you okay?"

[Ishaan swings on the swing.]

Shalini: "Ishaan, listen!"

[Ishaan plays with his dog.]

Ishaan (softly): "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "So, here we are!"

[Ishaan whispers something to Mother.]

Ishaan: "That was fun!"

[Ishaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Ishaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Ishaan paints a picture.]

Ishaan: "Show me too!"

[Ishaan draws a picture of the house.]

Shalini: "Good job, Ishaan!"

[Ishaan slips and falls.]

Shalini: "That was fun!"

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Ishaan: "Mom, listen!"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Shalini (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
